csv_project_name: AE for Reynolds Medical Sciences Building HVAC
csv_agency: Board of Regents Texas A And M University System
csv_scope_of_work: The Texas A&M University System Office of Facilities Planning & Construction (FP&C) on behalf of the Board of Regents of The Texas A&M University System (Owner) and Texas A&M University are soliciting statements of qualifications for selection of an Architect/Engineer (A/E) firm for the Reynolds Medical Sciences Building Level 2 HVAC Upgrade project (#02-3484) for Texas A&M University in College Station, Texas. The Reynolds Medical Sciences Building Level 2 HVAC Upgrades project will modernize the mechanical systems serving the second floor to improve ventilation performance, support laboratory safety, and ensure long-term operational reliability. The project scope includes replacing and modifying the existing air-handling units (AHUs) to provide 100% outside air, increasing the buildings capability to meet contemporary laboratory ventilation standards.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
